descriptions.text: Get ready to party all year long with the Birthday Card Organizer Kit! This kit comes with everything you need to help you get organized and never miss out on a birthday celebration. It comes with the supplies to make 12 birthday cards with matching envelopes that you can easily customize. This kit is filled with precut floral and background pieces to really make your crafts unique. And don't forget the 8" x 10" (20.3 x 25.4 cm) yearly birthday organizer with sticker sentiments in multiple language options for perfect (and practical) personalization! You can keep track of all your loved one's birthdays, then make and save a card for them in the cardholder for each month. No matter who you are celebrating, you can give them something great! Each kit comes with printed die-cut sentiments in Dutch, English, French, and German. Kit includes: * Designed projects * Step-by-step instructions * Precut pieces (No prep work! Get right to crafting) * Makes 12 cards: 6 each of 2 designs

descriptions.text: Little flowers send a big message when you use this Dainty Delight Stamp Set. Sure, they're dainty, but they’ll send a powerful message of hope, thanks, celebration, and more on all your paper crafting projects. Use these beautiful florals on your handmade cards and watch the smiles bloom! The line art images can be custom colored using your favorite Stampin’ Up! coloring technique. Stamp a single stem for a clean, minimalist look, or mix and match the images for a lovely field of dainty delights—no matter how you style them, you can’t go wrong with these delicate beauties! Also available in French.

descriptions.text: Lazy days are the best days when you share them with a loved one! The Lazy Days Stamp Set is the perfect way to take some time off and create something special for a friend, say thank you, or wish happy birthday. This set includes a variety of sentiments and artwork that can be used alone or paired together for more versatility. The open line-art images of the set feature a rocking chair, a rug, plants, birds, and more. Create a serene scene of a porch or use the image of your choice as the focal point on a card front. Fill in those open spaces using your favourite colouring technique and tools. And don't forget a sentiment! For a great scene, try the masking technique using the rocking chair and the rug, and add the floor texture by stamping it randomly or lining it up. This stamp set gives you so many creative possibilities! Shop this set today!

descriptions.text: Show someone you are there for them through sunshine and rain with the Growth Takes Time Stamp Set! This set comes with four sentiments that remind all of us that progress takes time. It also comes with three different tree sizes that show the development of a plant becoming something beautiful. You can color these trees to match any season of the year by using any coloring technique you want! Then top it off with some extra leaves or put the sweet watering can off to the side. It's time to nurture and care for our loved ones the same way we do a garden by sending them a paper craft today!

descriptions.text: The Earthen Elegance 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) Designer Series Paper is just as lively as the earth itself! With new colors and designs, this paper can be mixed and matched on one project or spread out over multiple projects. It's beautifully designed with you in mind, bringing the soft tones of nature right into all your card making crafts.

Stamp an image-a stethoscope, bandage, pencil, emergency light, or whistle-and sentiment, then give it to a deserving nurse, teacher, police officer, paramedic, or other community helper. The bold, line-art images are easy to stamp, so stamping multiples is simple. And they're perfect for coloring, making them a great choice for kids who want to make their own thank-you cards. You'll use this set over and over again, because you'll never run out of reasons to say thanks!

descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink pads like this Copper Clay Classic Stampin' Pad. Classic Stampin' Pads come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of color coordination. Many of our other products come in the same exclusive colors, so it's easy to pair stamp pads with cardstock, markers, embellishments, and more! The innovative ink pad design has a patented flip-top lid to keep the stamp pad inked during storage. The firm foam pads outlast felt pads and give you a superior stamping experience.

descriptions.text: If you think you don’t need additional Christmas supplies for paper crafting, think again! The Christmas Classics Stamp Set is the perfect addition to your Christmas stamps. It features small greenery designs as well as stylish Christmas greetings taken from classic Christmas songs. Combine the different sentiments on a card front, tag, or label to create a personalized, heartfelt project, and pair with the designs of your choice. You can also stamp the designs repeatedly to create a beautiful border on your card front or make unique backgrounds on all your projects! Also available in French.

descriptions.text: Create beautiful die-cut labels, tags, and more with the Christmas Classics Dies. This set features multiple greenery pieces and tags in all shapes and sizes for your Christmas paper crafting needs! Use one of the label die cuts as the focal piece of your card front, create peek-through cards using one of the textures pieces, or make elegant tags for your gift and treat packaging projects. You’ll love the versatility this die set offers during the Christmas season!

descriptions.text: Fill your paper crafts with music and a touch of gold foil this Christmas season with the Joyful 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) Specialty Designer Series Paper. Partly hand-drawn, this paper is great for card making and features an eclectic selection of four designs: holly berry leaves, tartan, wood grain, and music notes. While this paper will embellish your Christmas projects, it’s also versatile and can be used all year long! Include some music notes when crafting for all your music lovers, use the woodgrain as as staple on any projects, and the green tartan pattern is great for autumn paper crafts!

images.description: A decorative paper or cardstock collection featuring four coordinating vertical strips with distinct patterns: a gold wood grain texture with white accents, a red background with musical notes in gold, a cream base with red berries and tan botanical branches, and a teal green plaid pattern with gold accents.

A square decorative paper or cardstock featuring a wood grain pattern in gold, tan, and cream tones with white line details and knots throughout. The design mimics natural wood texture with vertical grain lines and circular tree ring elements in varying shades of gold.

A decorative paper or cardstock product featuring a red background with gold musical notation and staff lines arranged in horizontal rows. The design has a classic, elegant appearance suitable for musical or festive themed crafting projects.

A square patterned paper or cardstock sheet featuring a repeating design of delicate botanical branches with small red berries scattered throughout on a cream or off-white background. The design has a naturalistic, festive aesthetic with gold-toned leaf accents.

A green plaid patterned cardstock or paper sheet featuring a tartan-style design in teal and yellow/gold tones. The pattern consists of evenly spaced horizontal and vertical lines creating a classic plaid weave across the entire surface.

descriptions.text: Add a note of something extra special to your classic Christmas creations with the Loose Holly Gems & Sequins. This pack of loose gems includes green holly leaves, red circles that can be used as holly berries, and gold music notes. The loose gems are excellent for shaker cards or tags, or you can adhere the pieces to any project to make them sparkle and shine. The music notes can be used well past the holiday season on projects for all the music lovers in your life!

images.description: A festive assortment of decorative sequins and embellishments featuring holiday-themed designs in red, green, and gold colors. The collection includes small metallic red circular sequins, green holly leaf shapes with metallic accents, and gold-colored reindeer silhouettes arranged on a white background.

A collection of four decorative embellishments displayed on a white background, consisting of two red rhinestone circles of varying sizes, a gold musical note charm, and a teal/green holly leaf charm with textured detailing.

descriptions.text: Tie up your gifts and cards with the Black & Very Vanilla 3/8" (1 cm) Large Check Ribbon. This gingham ribbon looks glamourous with classic Christmas colors of red and green for your gifts, tags, cards, and treat packaging. It also adds a rustic look to autumn-themed projects. You can dye the ribbon any color using our Classic Stampin’ Inks to fully customize a special embellishment for your projects. No matter the season or occasion, you’ll find lots of reasons to craft with this classic ribbon.

images.description: A black and white gingham patterned ribbon product, featuring checkered design with coordinating metallic silver accents. The ribbon is displayed in a loose, flowing arrangement on a neutral background, showing the texture and width of the material.

descriptions.text: The Joy of Christmas Suite Collection is sure to complement all your Christmas paper crafting supplies. This versatile suite collection includes two set of dies and stamp sets that you can pair nicely. Create peek-through cards, gift packaging tags, gorgeous Christmas wreaths, and more! Stamp elegant and stylish greetings that include lyrics from Christmas songs. Embellish your projects with colorful papers featuring holly berry leaves, Christmas patterns, music notes, and more versatile styles and designs. Add a final touch to your projects using some check ribbon and holly gems to make your crafts even more jolly and special! Also available in French.

descriptions.text: Impress friends and family with the O Holy Night Designer Series Paper! With 12 dazzling, hand-painted sheets of paper, this paper is sure to be a great addition to your Christmas cards and gift tags. Use the desert or old city scenes as a background to a Nativity scene or layer the starry night sky sheets on the sandy-colored paper to add extra depth and dimension. While each page of the paper works well on its own, it can also be paired together for other paper crafting projects.

descriptions.text: Make the birth of Christ the central focus of your Christmas cards this season with the Night Divine Dies. This die set includes a detailed wooden stable and a die showcasing a manger scene. This set also includes individual animal dies and cloud dies. Center the stable in the middle of your card with the figures cradled inside. Or place the figures in the middle of your card with clouds above. You can also use the animal dies to create an scene that sets the stage of the babe being born in Bethlehem.
